sentences.en: KAEDEN: Hello Charlotte
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 你好，夏洛特。

sentences.en: I'm Kaeden, one of the supervisors
sentences.zh: 我是凯登，是主管之一。

sentences.en: Welcome to the team
sentences.zh: 欢迎加入团队。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: Hi Aiden
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 你好，艾登。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: It's Kaeden
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 是凯登。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: I'm so sorry
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 非常抱歉。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: Don't worry
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 别担心。

sentences.en: People often get my name wrong; they never know how to spell it
sentences.zh: 人们经常把我的名字念错；他们从来不知道该怎么拼写。

sentences.en: It's K-A-E-D-E-N, in case you ever need to write it
sentences.zh: 拼写是K-A-E-D-E-N，以防你将来需要写下来。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: I'll try and remember
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 我会努力记住的。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: So, there are a few practical things you need o sort out this morning
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 所以，今天上午你需要处理几件实际事务。

sentences.en: Then I'll show you what you're going to do today
sentences.zh: 之后我会向你介绍今天要做的工作。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: The email received said to go to the front desk, to show my letter of appointment and pick up my badge
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 我收到的邮件说，要去前台出示我的录用通知书并领取工牌。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: You'll need that for the staffroom and other areas of the supermarket where shoppers aren't allowed
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 你需要这个工牌才能进入员工休息室以及超市内顾客禁止入内的其他区域。

sentences.en: So, after you've finished at the front desk, I'll take you to the staffroom
sentences.zh: 因此，在前台办完手续后，我带你去员工休息室。

sentences.en: Put your coat and rucksack in one of the lockers there
sentences.zh: 把你的外套和背包放进那里的一个储物柜里。

sentences.en: Take whichever one is free
sentences.zh: 随便选一个空着的柜子即可。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: Will have a key?
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 我会有钥匙吗？

sentences.en: KAEDEN: Yes
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 是的。

sentences.en: Try not to lose it
sentences.zh: 请尽量别弄丢了。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, leave it in the door for the next person to use. to
sentences.zh: 下班时，把钥匙留在柜门上，供下一位使用者使用。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: Will do
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 好的，明白了。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: You also need to go to the HR department to see Tiffany
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 你还需要去人力资源部见蒂芙尼。

sentences.en: She's really helpful
sentences.zh: 她非常乐于助人。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: I was told to bring my passport with me
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 我被告知要随身携带护照。

sentences.en: HR need to take a note of the number in it
sentences.zh: 人力资源部需要记录护照上的号码。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: That's right
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 没错。

sentences.en: Or you can show your ID card
sentences.zh: 或者你也可以出示身份证。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: I don't have one of those
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 我没有那种证件。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: OK
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 好的。

sentences.en: Tiffany will give you a uniform
sentences.zh: 蒂芙尼会给你发放制服。

sentences.en: They have lots in different sizes, so you just tell her what you need
sentences.zh: 他们备有各种尺码的制服，你只需告诉她你需要哪一种。

sentences.en: I won't come with you to HR - I've got to go and sort something else out
sentences.zh: 我不会陪你一起去人力资源部——我得去处理别的事情。

sentences.en: Problem with a bread slicer
sentences.zh: 面包切片机出了点问题。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: Is the HR office near the staffroom?
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 人力资源部办公室靠近员工休息室吗？

sentences.en: KAEDEN: The staffroom's on the first floor, and HR are a couple of floors above that, on the third a floor
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 员工休息室在一层，而人力资源部则在它上面几层，即三层。

sentences.en: There's a staircase outside the staffroom
sentences.zh: 员工休息室外有一座楼梯。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: OK
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 好的。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: When you've finished with HR, come and find me in the bakery section of the shop
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 你办完人力资源部的事后，请到商店的烘焙区来找我。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: I'm looking forward to getting started
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 我很期待马上开始工作。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: I'll just give you my phone number, in case you can't find me
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 我把我的电话号码给你，以防你找不到我。

sentences.en: Have you got your phone there?
sentences.zh: 你手机带在身上了吗？

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: Yes OK, ready
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 好的，没问题，准备好了。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: It's oh-four-one-two double-six-five nine-oh-three
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 是0412双六五九零三。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: OK, done
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 好的，记下了。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: So, Charlotte, your lasks today are in the bakery section, on the sushi counter, and on the meat and fish counters
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 所以，夏洛特，你今天的工作任务在烘焙区、寿司柜台以及肉品和水产柜台。

sentences.en: The first job is to check sell-by dates on the bread and cakes. f any of the dates are today's, put a new price label on the packaging
sentences.zh: 第一项工作是检查面包和蛋糕的保质期；如果保质期是今天，就在包装上贴一张新的价格标签。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: What if any of the labels are yesterday's dates, or older?
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 如果有些标签上的日期是昨天或更早呢？

sentences.en: Do throw those items away?
sentences.zh: 这些商品要直接扔掉吗？

sentences.en: KAEDEN: Yes, but that shouldn't happen - we check the stock every day
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 是的，但这种情况本不该发生——我们每天都会检查库存。

sentences.en: When something needs a new price label, put a yellow one on the package, next to the original price
sentences.zh: 当某件商品需要新价格标签时，请在原价标签旁边贴一张黄色标签。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: OK
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 好的。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: After that, you'll go to the sushi takeaway counter
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 接下来，你去寿司外带柜台。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: Will be preparing boxes of food?
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 我要负责准备食品盒吗？

sentences.en: KAEDEN: For today, you'll just be helping the staff
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 今天你只需协助工作人员。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: Yes, of course
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 好的，当然可以。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: You'll see lots of flat cardboard boxes at one end of the counter
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 你会在柜台一端看到许多扁平的纸板箱。

sentences.en: Beneath those is where we keep the plastic boxes - we run out of those really quickly, so you should bring more from the storeroom
sentences.zh: 纸板箱下面是我们存放塑料盒的地方——塑料盒消耗得特别快，所以你需要从仓库多取一些过来。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: Is that my only task on the sushi counter?
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 这就是我在寿司柜台唯一的任务吗？

sentences.en: KAEDEN: No
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 不是。

sentences.en: You also need to clean the area where they prepare the dishes
sentences.zh: 你还需要清洁员工制作菜肴的区域。

sentences.en: There are cloths and bottles of spray by the sink
sentences.zh: 水槽旁有抹布和喷雾瓶。

sentences.en: Oh, and please make sure you clean that too
sentences.zh: 哦，对了，请务必也把水槽清洗干净。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: Sure
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 好的。

sentences.en: That's important, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这很重要，对吧？

sentences.en: KAEDEN: Absolutely
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 绝对重要。

sentences.en: But you mustn't wash up knives
sentences.zh: 但你千万不能清洗刀具。

sentences.en: You have to do some training before you're allowed to touch sharp objects
sentences.zh: 在获准接触锋利物品之前，你必须先接受相关培训。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: What should I do if there are any?
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 如果遇到刀具，我该怎么办？

sentences.en: KAEDEN: Ask someone to put them in the dishwasher
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 请找人把它们放进洗碗机。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: OK, thanks
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: I don't want to get anything wrong
sentences.zh: 我不想出任何差错。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: Don't worry
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 别担心。

sentences.en: You'll be fine
sentences.zh: 你会做得很棒的。

sentences.en: And I'll be around to help
sentences.zh: 而且我会一直在附近帮忙。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: Right
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 好的。

sentences.en: KAEDEN: Finally, the meat and fish counters
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 最后是肉品和水产柜台。

sentences.en: You need to clean the area where staff serve customers, including wiping the weighing scales
sentences.zh: 你需要清洁员工为顾客服务的区域，包括擦拭电子秤。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: OK
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 好的。

sentences.en: Anything else?
sentences.zh: 还有别的事吗？

sentences.en: KAEDEN: The fish is laid on ice, but when that starts to melt, you'll need to get more from the cold-room
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 鱼被放在冰上，但当冰开始融化时，你就需要从冷藏室再取一些冰。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: I know the staff on the food counters wear a hat
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 我知道食品柜台的工作人员要戴帽子。

sentences.en: Will that be the same for me?
sentences.zh: 那我是不是也要一样？

sentences.en: KAEDEN: You won't be serving customers directly, so no
sentences.zh: KAEDEN: 你不会直接为顾客提供服务，所以不用。

sentences.en: But make sure you put on thermal gloves when you take anything out of the cold-room
sentences.zh: 但当你从冷藏室取出任何物品时，务必戴上隔热手套。

sentences.en: The temperature's low enough in there to get frostbite from touching things
sentences.zh: 那里面的温度足够低，接触物品可能导致冻伤。

sentences.en: CHARLOTTE: Understood
sentences.zh: CHARLOTTE: 明白了。
